title: Product Comparison Table
prompt: Create a comparison table with a caption, at least two product columns, and one spanning group heading.
objective: Create a valid grid with a visible caption and appropriate scope values.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: table headings, captions, spanning.
hints: Use th for table headings and make sure colspan matches the number of columns it spans.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Use th for table headings and make sure colspan matches the number of columns it spans. Required structural evidence: <caption>, <th, colspan=, scope=.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
